title: 第二十三章 天地银行大班大丰收第二十四章 针锋相对

“这次是你运气好，赶上了阴司衙门改革的风口。不过这职务是机遇，也是煞位，没气运做不久，没能耐做不好，你心里要有数。”阵阵阴风吹白雾，将两道身影送至大堂前，其中青衣官员扭头看着九叔，严肃叮嘱。
九叔肃穆的表情中带着一抹喜色，颔首受教：“我明白，多谢老祖的鼎力相助。”
青衣官员摆了摆手：“茅山能跻身名教，靠的就是茅山弟子万众一心，团结互助，今日我帮你，他日或许就是你帮我了……”
“拜见老祖。”这时，听到动静的秦尧拽着四目走出大堂，主动迎了过去。
青衣官员看起来心情大好，笑着开口：“不必多礼，等着急了吧？”
“没有没有。”四目赔笑道。
他本有心说两句恭维的话，哪怕拍马屁都没关系，然而事到跟前，话到嘴边，却又突然词穷，说出的话自然干干巴巴，几近废话。
“多谢老祖，恭喜师父。”所幸旁边还站着秦尧，一句话讲到了点子上，不经意间为他解了围。
青衣官员赞许道：“你是一个聪明的，与林九相得益彰。”
秦尧笑了笑，坦然自若：“看老祖与师父的脸色，封官一事儿想必是成了，不知是个什么官儿，竟令二位如此开心？”
“林九，你与他们说吧。”青衣官员道。
“是，老祖。”
九叔应了一句，朝向秦尧道：“因为阳间人为阴间亲人烧的纸钱太杂太乱，导致阴间钞纸愈发混乱。
阴司高层就此现状展开改革，计划在人间成立一批天地银行，银行管理者为大班，虽是一个九流末，但职权却不小，堪称位低权重。”
秦尧微微一怔。
他倒是清楚的记得，在僵尸至尊这部戏中，九叔就是一家天地银行的大班，甚至很有人情味的将冥纸金额连年增长，让那些买正版冥纸的家庭真正能够孝敬到先祖……却没想到这官职居然应在此处。
反正不管有没有他在，九叔都能坐上银行大班的位置，那岂不是说自己白嫖了一波？
刚想到这里，他脑海中便响起系统的声音：【恭喜，帮助林九获得天地银行大班的位置，奖励孝心值500点。】
【恭喜，您目前的孝心值为550点，达到了系统升级的水准，请问是否开始优化升级?】

秦尧心神一颤，眸光亮起。
颤抖的心不是因为系统可以优化升级了，而是因为他好像摸索出了“九叔”这个金手指的正确使用方法。
单纯尽孝，令其感动，虽然也能获得孝心值，但收获的速度实在太慢了。反而是令九叔变得更好，更强，更有地位，不管是明里还是暗里，他得到的好处都是最多。
‘九叔啊九叔，弟子掐指一算，你有当阎王的命！’秦尧抬头望向九叔，这一刻，眸光闪耀，灿若星辰。
“怎么了，为何这么看着我？”九叔对上他的视线，疑惑问道。
“没事，为您开心。”秦尧呵呵一笑，随口答道。
如果不是此间有作为阴司官员的老祖在，他少不了要说一句我看吾师有大帝之姿。但守着老祖的面，还是低调一些为好，以免真心话被人当做轻浮。
“时候不早了，你们回去慢慢开心，老祖我还有事情需要处理。”青衣官员忽然讲道。
“是。”九叔带着四目与秦尧一起行礼。
青衣官员说话利落，做事更利落，当即驱动院中阵法，将三名后生全部甩向阳间！
茅山二圣殿前，飞升台上，金色的阵法纹路光芒一闪，中心处凭空浮现出三道身影。
“这么快？事情办成了吗？”秋云水在台下问道。

"You are lucky this time and have caught up with the reform of the Yin Si Yamen. However, this position is an opportunity, but it is also a disadvantage. If you are not lucky, you will not be able to do it for a long time, and if you do not have the ability, you must know it well." A gust of cold wind blew the white mist, sending two figures to the front of the lobby. Among them, the Tsing Yi official turned to look at Uncle Jiu and gave a serious warning.
There was a hint of joy in Uncle Jiu's solemn expression, and he nodded in acceptance: "I understand, thank you ancestor for your help."
The official in Tsing Yi waved his hand: "Maoshan's success in becoming a famous sect depends on the unity and mutual help of Maoshan's disciples. Today I help you, and maybe you will help me in the future..."
"Greetings to the ancestor." At this time, Qin Yao, who heard the movement, walked out of the lobby with his eyes pulled, and took the initiative to greet him.
The official in Tsing Yi seemed to be in a good mood and said with a smile: "No need to be polite, are you anxious for the wait?"
"No, no." Simu said with a smile.
He originally intended to say a few words of compliment, even if it was flattering, it didn't matter. However, when the matter came to a close, when the words came to his lips, he suddenly ran out of words, and what he said was naturally dry and almost nonsense.
"Thank you, ancestor, and congratulations, master." Fortunately, Qin Yao was still standing next to him, and he got to the point with one sentence, and inadvertently helped him out.
The Qingyi official praised: "You are a smart person, and you complement Lin Jiu perfectly."
Qin Yao smiled and said calmly: "Looking at the faces of the ancestor and master, the appointment of officials must have been completed. I wonder what kind of official it is that makes the two of you so happy?"
"Lin Jiu, please talk to them." The Qingyi official said.
"Yes, ancestor."
Uncle Jiu responded and said to Qin Yao: "Because the paper money burned by people in the underworld for their relatives in the underworld is too messy and messy, the paper money in the underworld has become increasingly chaotic.
The senior officials of the Yin Division started to reform the current situation and planned to establish a group of heaven and earth banks in the human world. The bank managers would be Taipan. Although he was a low-level person, his authority was not small and he could be regarded as a low-ranking bank. "
Qin Yao was slightly startled.
He clearly remembered that in the movie "Zombie Supreme", Uncle Ninth was the chief executive of a Tiandi Bank, and he even humanely increased the amount of paper money year after year, so that families who bought genuine paper money could truly honor their ancestors... but he did not expect that this official position should be here.
Anyway, regardless of whether he was there or not, Uncle Jiu could sit in the position of a bank clerk. Doesn't that mean that he was a prostitute in vain?
As soon as he thought of this, the system's voice sounded in his mind: [Congratulations, you helped Lin Jiu obtain the position of top class member of Tiandi Bank, and you will be rewarded with 500 filial piety points. 】
[Congratulations, your current filial piety value is 550 points, which has reached the level of system upgrade. Do you want to start optimizing and upgrading? 】
Qin Yao's heart trembled and his eyes lit up.
The trembling heart was not because the system could be optimized and upgraded, but because he seemed to have figured out the correct way to use the golden finger of "Uncle Nine".
Simple filial piety moved him. Although he could gain filial piety points, the harvest speed was too slow. On the contrary, it made Uncle Jiu better, stronger, and more prestigious. Whether it was overtly or covertly, he got the most benefits.
‘Uncle Ninth, Uncle Ninth, I’ll tell you with my fingers that you are destined to be the King of Hell! ’ Qin Yao raised his head and looked at Uncle Jiu. At this moment, his eyes were shining like stars.
"What's wrong, why are you looking at me like that?" Uncle Jiu met his gaze and asked doubtfully.
"It's okay, I'm happy for you." Qin Yao chuckled and replied casually.
If the ancestor who is an official of the Yin Division were not here, he would have to say, "I think my master has the appearance of a great emperor." But for the sake of my ancestors, it is better to keep a low profile, so as not to be regarded as frivolous by telling the truth.
"It's getting late. You go back and be happy. Ancestor, I still have things to deal with." The Tsing Yi official suddenly said.
"Yes." Uncle Jiu saluted Qin Yao with his four eyes.
The official in Tsing Yi spoke sharply and acted even more neatly. He immediately activated the formation in the courtyard and threw all three juniors towards Yang.between!
In front of the Second Holy Temple of Maoshan, on the ascending platform, the golden formation patterns flashed, and three figures emerged out of thin air in the center.
"So fast? Is the matter done?" Qiu Yunshui asked in the audience.
